// Positive fixture: every cfg'd construct below ENDS early (a field, a
// variant, a match arm), so each production hit after it MUST be reported.
// Also the lexer's hard cases. Read as TEXT by
// tests/workspace_assumptions_are_enumerated.rs; never compiled.
struct Handles {
    #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
    stdout_raw_handle: Option<isize>,
    #[cfg(test)]
    test_only: HashMap<String, u8>,
    name: String,
}

fn after_cfg_field() -> &'static str {
    "http://localhost:8000"
}

enum Mode {
    Prod,
    #[cfg(test)]
    Test,
}

fn after_cfg_variant() -> &'static str {
    "http://localhost:3001"
}

fn cfg_match_arm(m: Mode) -> &'static str {
    match m {
        #[cfg(test)]
        Mode::Test => "/home/test-only-arm",
        Mode::Prod => "D:/after/arm",
    }
}

fn after_cfg_match_arm() -> &'static str {
    "C:/after/the/match"
}

fn lexer_raw_string() -> &'static str {
    let _ = r#"a "quoted" // not a comment"#;
    "/home/someone/after-raw"
}

/* outer /* nested */ "http://localhost:8000" still inside the outer comment */
fn lexer_nested_comment() -> &'static str {
    "C:/after/nested"
}

fn lexer_chars() -> (char, char, &'static str) {
    ('\'', '/', "http://127.0.0.1:9875/x")
}

fn lexer_lifetime<'a>(x: &'a str) -> &'a str {
    let _: &'a str = "localhost:6379";
    x
}

#[cfg(windows)]
impl Handles {
    fn windows_method_without_sibling() {}
}

#[cfg(windows)]
mod win_outer {
    #[cfg(test)]
    mod tests {
        fn inner_test() -> &'static str {
            "http://localhost:8000"
        }
    }
}

fn after_nested_regions() -> u16 {
    9875
}
